name: SUNO | 200mg Tincture | Permanent Marker
description:
SUNO THC Tincture is formulated with 100% all-natural refined hemp seed oil and contains 200mg THC per bottle. 

Each dropper is metered to allow for accurate dosing every single time. SUNO THC tincture does not contain any nut oil and is made with hemp seed oil (refined/golden) to offer a 100% cannabis based tincture. 

Each bottle contains 30mL of tincture and provides 6.7mg THC per serving (equal to 30 servings/bottle).
